diagram_math_checks.result: The object is F^{-1}(0) for F:R^3 -> R, F=x^2+y^2-z^2 (Given, steps 1.1–1.2). The explicitly declared linear drawing map P:R^3 -> R^2 is P(x,y,z)=(x+0.6y,z+0.25y); its domain and codomain are drawing spaces, not a mathematical coordinate chart for the cone. The caption explicitly disclaims inference of spatial intersections from projected intersections.

At z=±2, the cone sections are (2 cos θ,2 sin θ,±2), with F=4−4=0. P gives exactly the two plotted curves (2 cos θ+1.2 sin θ,±2+0.5 sin θ), 0≤θ≤360 degrees. The four unarrowed segments end at P(-2,0,2)=(-2,2), P(0,-2,2)=(-1.2,1.5), P(-2,0,-2)=(-2,-2), P(0,-2,-2)=(-1.2,-2.5). Every segment is the projection of a cone generator because F(tv)=t^2 F(v)=0.

The three arrows start at the apex and point outward to P(2,0,2)=(2,2), P(2,0,-2)=(2,-2), and P(0,2,2)=(1.2,2.5). They represent t(1,0,1), t(1,0,-1), t(0,1,1), with t≥0, displayed to t=2; labels are direction vectors, not endpoint coordinates. Each vector satisfies x^2+y^2=z^2. The determinant of these three columns is 2, hence they are independent exactly as asserted in step 2.1. No two-dimensional tangent plane or false projected independence is asserted.

The only marked spatial vertex is 0. Step 1.1 computes DF(0)=0 and rank 0; step 1.2 computes nonzero row (2x,2y,-2z) and rank 1 at every other cone point. The actual regular/critical definition uses surjectivity of DF:R^3 -> R; def-euclidean-submersions-and-immersions equates this with rank 1, and the local-graph supplier requires regularity. Figure labels state exactly these ranks and do not assert that 0 is regular or that the zero value is globally regular.

Standalone native dark PNG shows one marked apex, three outward arrow segments, four unarrowed generator segments, two complete closed section curves and six text labels (three vectors, equation, two rank annotations). All three arrows visibly meet the same apex and point to the intended section. This is a geometric wireframe, not a directed graph; no named-node cycle or commutative relation occurs. No clipping or label overlap was observed. The original four proof steps are byte-identical and complete without the figure.
